description: This file defines custom Cypress commands for testing the dashboard application, including API mocking, user authentication, and data seeding. It primarily configures intercepts for API endpoints related to users, reports, and charts.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Sets up intercepts for various API endpoints used in testing, including login, user CRUD operations, report CRUD operations, and chart data endpoints.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Automates the login process through UI for tests, filling in the email and password fields and submitting the login form.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Seeds the local storage with a fake JWT token for authenticated testing without UI interaction.
